title: LLM-C3MOD: A Human-LLM Collaborative System for Cross-Cultural Hate Speech Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the hate speech detection accuracy of LLMs and non-native human moderators on culturally-specific Korean text (KOLD dataset), specifically categorizing samples into cultural knowledge, cultural sentiment, and internet culture, and measuring performance improvements when providing RAG-enhanced cultural context annotations.
